chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 1 My childhood best friend and I grew up together , inseparable for eighteen years . He told me there was a surprise for me at the Freshman Welcome Show and insisted I get onstage . I walked up there , practically glowing . When the lights came up . Sloane Whitaker strode over with a pair of scissors , and Ryan Shaw pinned my shoulders from behind . Snip . My long hair fell to the floor in strands , and the whole auditorium erupted in laughter : Ryan laughed the loudest .

The next day , when he found out I'd filed the paperwork to withdraw from school , his expression changed in an instant . Just because of a joke , you're really withdrawing ? " he demanded . I turned , perfectly calm . " Yeah . " Down in the crowd . Ryan waved at me , his eyes startlingly bright . " Anna Grant , get up here . Surprise , remember ? " The crowd roared , and the Freshman Welcome Show was already at its peak . I was the emcee , and I'd just introduced the next act . Holding my cue cards , I smiled at him and started down the stage steps .

He sprinted over , grabbed my wrist , and his grip was a little too tight . " Not down ." he said , hauling me the other way . " Up . " I blinked , thrown . " What surprise ? " " Get up there and you'll see , " he said , pushing me toward center stage like it was nothing . " We've only got a couple minutes during the changeover . " The spotlight hit my face , harsh and blinding white , and I lifted a hand to shield my eyes . The seating disappeared into darkness , and all I could hear was the low buzz of voices rolling together . Unease crawled up my spine , sweat dampening my palm .

Ryan stepped behind me and set both hands on my shoulders . pressing down gently at first . It was a gesture I'd known my whole life , the same steady pressure he'd always used to tell me not to be nervous . I took a breath and lowered my hand . Someone came on from the other side of the stage . It was Sloane , the girl everyone called the beauty of our department . in a pretty white tulle dress with her long hair curled into polished waves like a princess . A pair of silver scissors gleamed in her hand . My stomach dropped , and I couldn't make sense of it - was this some kind of prank ?

Netshort I tilted my head , trying to look back at Ryan and ask what this was . His hands tightened without warning , clamping down so hard I couldn't move . The smile on my face froze . Sloane stopped in front of me , wearing a sweet little grin , and lifted the scissors to wag them in my line of sight . Whistles and excited whoops rose from the crowd . " Ryan , this is the surprise you promised ? " Sloane's voice carried through the microphone and filled the auditorium . " You said you'd give me a gift to prove your sincerity . " All the blood in my body turned cold .

I tried to wrench free , but Ryan held me down like a vise , his fingers digging into my skin . " Ryan , what are you doing ? " My voice shook . He didn't answer . He just let out a low laugh beside my ear , light as breath and sharp as a needle . Sloane pinched a lock of hair that fell over my chest . My hair had been long , nearly to my waist , never permed or dyed . and it was the thing I treasured most . " I heard you've been growing it out for a long time , " she said , her tone innocent and cruel at the same time . Someone in the crowd shouted , " Cut it ! Cut it !

" Then more voices joined , until it became a chant . " Cut it ! Cut it ! " I stared at Sloane , at the vicious curve of her smile , and tried with everything in me to turn my head and see Ryan's face . I couldn't move . Snip . The crisp sound cracked through the air , and for one breath my world went silent . A black strand drifted down in front of my eyes and landed on the shiny stage floor . Then came a second cut , and a third . Snip , snip , snip . Sloane worked like a kid who'd just gotten a new toy , focused and delighted , taking scissors to my hair again and again .

Short pieces fell across my shoulders and down my neck , prickling like tiny needles . A chill slid over the back of my head as a thick section came away , and cold air rushed in where it had been . The auditorium exploded with laughter and applause that hit like thunder . Behind me , Ryan laughed too . I felt it in the shake of his chest , and his laugh was louder than anyone's , sharp and grating . Eighteen years . I'd known him for eighteen years .

I stopped struggling and let him hold me there while she ruined what I'd loved , I just stood still and looked out at the blurred , celebrating faces . Chapter 1 10 00 Netshort I didn't know how long it took before Sloane finally stopped . She admired her work , tossed the scissors to the floor with a clatter , and smiled . " Alright , Ryan . " she said with a sweet smile . " I got the message . " Then she pranced off the stage like a princess taking a bow , lifting her skirt as she went . The pressure on my shoulders eased , and Ryan let go .

He patted the top of my head , and little bits of hair fluttered down . " So. " he said , pleased with himself , like this had been a harmless prank . " Surprised enough ? Don't be mad . It'll grow back . " I didn't look at him . I turned and walked , step by step , toward the stairs . My hair felt strangely light now , hacked uneven and jagged , like a dog had gotten to it . The laughter didn't stop . I walked off the stage and through all those amused faces watching me like I was a clown . I didn't cry . Not a single tear . I just thought those eighteen years were a joke .

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 2 When I got back to the dorm , it was empty . My roommates were still at the show , talking about the night's biggest " joke . " I stopped in front of the mirror . The person staring back at me had messy , hacked - off hair , nearly shaved to the scalp in some spots , with random tufts still hanging on in others . It looked ridiculous . It looked laughable . I lifted a hand and touched the back of my neck . It was bare , and the sensation felt unfamiliar . I stared at myself without expression , for a long time .

Then I opened my closet , pulled out my biggest suitcase , and laid it flat on the floor . I started packing . I packed one item , then another , then another . I folded my clothes . I stacked my books . I bagged up my toiletries . My hands moved at a steady , orderly pace , the same way they had every time I'd cleaned up after Ryan for the past eighteen years , straightening the mess he left behind in his room and his backpack . My phone on the desk kept vibrating like crazy . Ryan was calling . I didn't answer . Then the WhatsApp messages came in . Ryan : ( Anna , where'd you go ?

Are you seriously mad ? ] Ryan : [ It was just a joke . You're not that petty , are you ? ] Ryan : [ Sloane and I are just messing around . Don't read into it . ) Ryan : [ Hello ? Say something . ] Ryan : [ Damn , is this really necessary ? ] I read each line slowly , then flipped my phone facedown on the desk . The world went quiet . I kept packing . For eighteen years , my life had revolved around him . To get into the same elementary school . I'd begged my mom to pull strings . To end up in the same middle school , I'd studied like my life depended on it .

To make it to the same college , I'd even given up a major that would've fit me better . He'd said . " Anna , we'll always be together , " and I believed him . Chapter 2 20 day Netshort He'd said . " Anna , you've got me in college . Nobody's going to mess with you ," and I believed him . He'd said . " Anna . I've got a surprise for you tonight , " and I'd been thrilled . The suitcase filled up fast . I pulled the zipper closed and stood it by the door . The door opened , and my roommate came in . She looked at me , then at the suitcase , and froze . " Anna , what are you doing ?

" she asked . Her gaze drifted to my hair , and her expression pinched with awkwardness and sympathy . " It's nothing . " I said evenly . " I'm going home for a bit . " " Oh . " She hesitated . " About your hair ... do you want to go to a salon and have it fixed ? " " No. " I said . There was no point anymore . That night , I slept well . I didn't dream , and I didn't cry . Before the sun was fully up . I woke again . I didn't wake my roommate . I washed up quietly , got dressed , and dragged my suitcase out of the dorm building .

The campus was hushed in the early morning , with only birdsong and the soft scrape of a custodian's broom . I went straight to the administration building . My academic advisor's office was still locked , so I sat down on the bench outside and waited At eight , he showed up yawning . When he saw me , he looked startled . " Anna ? This early ? And your hair ... " He'd clearly heard what happened the night before . " Sir , I want to withdraw from the university , " I said , standing and handing him the withdrawal request form I'd already filled out last night .

The surprise on his face turned into shock . He took off his glasses , rubbed his eyes , put them back on , and looked at me carefully , like he was making sure I was real " Withdraw ? Why ? " he demanded . " Anna , you've only been here a month Your grades are strong . What is going on ? " " Personal reasons , " I said, the same answer as before . Chapter 2 Netshort Is this because of last night ? " he asked , lowering his voice . " What Ryan and Sloane did was out of line . I was going to call them in today and make them apologize to you in public .

" " No , sir , " I said , shaking my head . " It has nothing to do with them . This is my decision . " " You're being stubborn , " he snapped , frustrated . " You're really going to throw everything away over this ? What do you think your parents will say ? What about the eighteen years you've worked for this - was that all just a joke to you ? " I looked at him and didn't speak . It had been eighteen years . And again , it was eighteen years . To everyone else , my eighteen years seemed to be worth no more than the weight of a " joke .

" When he realized he couldn't change my mind , he let out a long sigh and started the process . He made a few calls and told me where to go next , the registrar , the bursar , then the library . I carried a form from office to office , getting one bright red stamp after another . Every stamp felt like a final period being pressed onto my past . The sun was bright , and the trees looked impossibly green . I spotted Ryan walking with Sloane across the quad . He had breakfast in his hand and was smiling as he said something to her . They saw me too ..

Sloane's eyes paused on me for a second , openly contemptuous , and then she looked away . Ryan's expression shifted , complicated and tense . He started toward me , then Sloane tugged him back . I didn't slow down . I walked past them without looking , straight ahead . At ten am , I got the final stamp . With my withdrawal confirmation in hand , I walked out of the administration building . From that moment on , the college I'd fought so hard to get into had nothing to do with me anymore .

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.content:
I dragged my suitcase toward the front gate . I'd already called a rideshare to the train station . " Anna ! " Ryan's voice came from behind me , sharp with anger and panic . I didn't stop . He ran up and grabbed my wrist , squeezing so hard it felt like he was trying to crush bone . " Where are you going ? " he demanded , eyes locked on the suitcase . " Home , " I said flatly . " Home ? " He stared at me like I was speaking another language . " So you're skipping class ? You've got class this morning . " " I'm not going , " I said . " What is that supposed to mean ?

" His brow furrowed , impatience flashing across his face . " You're still mad about last night ? I told you it was a joke . Why can't you just get over it ? " I looked at him and almost laughed . Auto - added to the Library Why did he think that if he apologized , I was wind to longer him ? truth was , he hadn't apologized at all . " I withdrew from the university , " I said , stating it like a fact . The impatience on his face froze . He blinked like he hadn't heard me . " You did what ?

" " I said I withdrew , " I repeated , and I tipped my wrist slightly , a wordless demand for him to let go . He didn't . He grabbed tighter . His face went pale right in front of me , the color draining so fast it was obvious , and his eyes filled with a frantic disbelief . " Withdrew ? " His voice jumped , loud enough that passing students turned to stare . " Are you out of your mind ? " Then he said the exact line I'd already heard in my head , * Just because of a joke , you're really withdrawing ?

" I watched his face , the face I'd known for eighteen years , and it suddenly felt like a stranger's Chapter 3 Netshort 30.002 I turned , perfectly calm . " Yeah . " That was all I gave him . Then I yanked my arm free . He staggered back two steps before he caught himself , like he hadn't expected me to be that strong . I took my suitcase and kept walking toward the gate . My rideshare was already pulled up at the curb . " Anna ! " Ryan shouted behind me , and there was a tremor in his voice he didn't seem to recognize . " Stop . Say it again . What do you mean you withdrew ?

You're not joking , right ? " I didn't answer . I opened the trunk and lifted my suitcase inside . Then I got in and shut the door . " Go . " I told the driver . Ryan ran up and slapped the window . " Anna , get out . You can't leave . " His voice cracked with urgency . " We've been together for eighteen years . You're going to blow it up over this ? " " If you withdrew , what am I supposed to do ? " he demanded . " What am I supposed to tell my parents , and yours ? " " Anna , open the door ! " I looked at him through the glass , at his twisted , frantic expression , and felt nothing .

The car rolled forward and left him behind . In the rearview mirror , I saw him chase the car for a few steps before he stopped , standing there where I'd left him , dazed , like an abandoned child . I looked away , leaned back , and closed my eyes . We'd had eighteen years together . It ended the moment he held me down so another girl could cut my hair in front of everyone . Chapter 3 Netshort 30.00 Now he was panicking . Not because I'd been hurt , but because things had slipped out of his control , and he couldn't explain it to both sets of parents .

That was the real reason he was terrified . I let out a slow breath . I felt a lightness I'd never known before . chapters.title: Chapter 4
chapters.content:
The train rolled along at a steady pace , the tracks beneath it keeping time with a rhythmic click - clack . Outside the window , the scenery streamed backward so fast that high - rises , fields , and low mountains blurred into a single ribbon of moving color . It was like my life , my college experience ripped out by the roots , and the longer past that stretched back a full eighteen years . I didn't cry , and I didn't even feel much grief . My phone had been vibrating in my pocket for a long time , and I never took it out . I didn't have to check to know who it was .

Nobody would be that frantic to reach me except Ryan . I leaned against the window and studied my reflection in the glass . The hair that had been hacked off like a dog had gotten hold of it was ugly and ridiculous , and somehow it also gave me a clarity I'd never felt before . How much had I really given up , and how much had I swallowed down , just to hold on to that so - called childhood - best - friends bond with Ryan ? He was careless and always losing things , and I followed behind him , cleaning up after him .

He nodded off in class and couldn't finish assignments , and I stayed up late filling in his notes and helping him work through the problems . He got into a conflict on the court , and I went to apologize for him . He got his heart broken , and I stayed up all night drinking with him , listening to him pour it all out . Everyone always said I treated Ryan so well . Ryan said it too , like it was a reflex . " Anna , what would I do without you ? " I used to think that meant we were close .

Now I could see it for what it was : I was playing the role of an on - call people - pleaser he could summon and dismiss whenever he wanted . And when he needed a ' proof of loyalty " to win over another girl , to fit into a shinier , more exclusive crowd , I was the easiest option . I was the most convenient one . I was the one who wouldn't make a big deal ' So he offered me up without hesitation . Eighteen years meant so little to him that he could turn it into a cheap stunt for laughs . My phone stopped buzzing for a while , then started up again . faster this time . That time .

I took it out . The caller ID flashed : Mrs. Shaw . It was Ryan's mom . Chapter 4 I answered and didn't say anything . " Hello ? " Her voice came through warm and familiar , with a faint , cautious edge . " Is this Anna ? " " Mrs. Shaw , " I said evenly . " It's me . " It sounded like she exhaled in relief . " Ryan said you didn't go to class today , and you weren't picking up . I was worried sick . Did you two get into a fight ? " Her tone was the same one adults used to soothe a kid having a tantrum . " We didn't get into a fight , " I said . " We didn't ?

" She pushed on , still light , still minimizing it . " Ryan told me everything . It was just a joke at the show , that's all . He cut a little bit of your hair . That boy is always acting up , and I'll deal with him , don't you worry . " She kept putting the emphasis on " joke " and " acting up . " " Men can be pretty clueless sometimes . Don't take it personally . Hair grows back . " I listened quietly until she finished . Every word felt like a thin needle , pricking at a heart that had already gone numb . So that was how they all saw it . A harmless joke .

My dignity , my humiliation , my pain , none of it mattered . ' Mrs. Shaw , " I cut in . " I withdrew from the university . " The line went dead silent , so quiet I could hear the faint hiss of the connection . A full five seconds passed before her voice came back , louder and sharp with disbelief . " What ? You ... what did you say ? Withdraw from the university ? Anna , don't joke like that . It isn't funny . " I'm not joking . " I said , slow and clear . " The withdrawal process is finished . I'm on a train home right now . " " Why would you do that ?

" Her voice snapped into a higher pitch , edged with accusation . " Because Ryan cut a little bit of your hair ? Over something this small ? Anna , aren't you being ridiculous ? " She barreled on without stopping . " You and Ryan grew up together . Our families ... " " Mrs. Shaw . " I interrupted again . I'm tired . I want to rest for a bit . When I get home , I'll explain everything to my parents . " " Hello ? Anna ! " Her voice turned shrill . " Don't hang up . You need to explain yourself right now ! " I didn't listen to another word . I ended the call .

The train car returned to quiet . I looked back out the window as the sky dimmed . In the distance , a city lit up in scattered points , like a spilled tray of jewels , bright and far away . There wasn't a place for me there anymore . That was for the best . A new start was better than drowning in the same mud . As for how Ryan and his family would weather the storm , that wasn't my problem to solve . chapters.title: Chapter 5
chapters.content:
When I stepped out of the train station , the air hit me right away , the kind my hometown always had : damp with humidity and gritty with dust . I dragged my suitcase forward and didn't hail a cab , choosing to walk home step by step . The streets were the same as always , the same storefronts , the same noisy chatter , like nothing had changed since I left . Only my headspace was unrecognizable . From a distance , I spotted our old apartment building . A light was on in the third - floor window , our kitchen . My steps slowed . I took a deep breath , then kept going .

I could already picture the storm waiting for me . Sure enough , the moment I unlocked the front door and pulled my suitcase inside , the easy atmosphere in the living room froze solid . Dad was on the couch watching the news . Mom was coming out of the kitchen with a plate of fruit . When she saw me and the massive suitcase behind me , the smile on her face stiffened . The plate slipped from her hands and clattered to the floor , apples and oranges rolling everywhere . " Anna ? " Her voice shook . " Why are you home ? Aren't you supposed to be at school ?

" Dad shot to his feet , his sharp gaze sweeping over me before landing on my jagged hair . His face darkened instantly . " What happened to your hair ? " he barked . " And what's with the suitcase ? " I didn't answer right away . I bent down and picked up the fruit one by one , set it back on the plate , and placed it neatly on the coffee table . Only then did I straighten up and look at them . " I withdrew from the university . " Those four words hit the small living room like a thunderclap . " What did you just say ? " Mom lunged toward me and grabbed my arm , eyes wide and bloodshot .

" Say it again . You withdrew ? Why ? You can't just quit college out of nowhere . " " Yeah , why ? " Dad roared , pacing back and forth like a trapped animal . He jabbed a finger toward my face . " We worked ourselves to the bone to get you there . Was it so you could throw your future in the trash ? Anna , are you out of your mind ? " He spun back toward me , still raging . " It's only been a month . You've only been there a month , and you come back here like this . I knew this was coming . Before they opened their mouths , Mrs. Shaw had definitely called .

And I didn't need to guess her version of the story , that I was immature , that I was being dramatic , that I'd thrown a tantrum over a harmless joke . " Is this because of Ryan ? " Mom pressed , a flicker of hope in her voice , like she wanted this to be something easy to fix . " His mom said you two had a little issue at school , and you got mad and ran home . " She rushed on , trying to smooth it over . " Even couples fight and make up by the next morning . You two grew up together . What can't you talk through ? " Her face tightened with anxiety .

" And over something this small , you come home and talk about withdrawing . What are the neighbors going to think of our family ? What's the Shaw family going to think of you ? " There it was again . They called it " something small . " It felt like my heart had been left in ice water until the last bit of warmth finally vanished . I didn't argue . I didn't scream . I didn't cry . I just lifted my chin and met their furious , confused stare , then pointed at my hair with a calm that felt almost cruel . Dad Mom . Look at my hair .

" They froze , their eyes snapping to the ugly , uneven mess on my head . 7 didn't cut this myself , " I said , enunciating every word " And it wasn't done at a salon " I said it slowly , word by word . " It happened at the Freshman Welcome Show . In front of a thousand students and faculty Ryan held me down to impress a girl named Sloane Whitaker while she took scissors to my hair , cut after cut , until if looked like this " I said " held me down ' and ' cut after cut ' slowly and clearly .

" Everyone was laughing I continued ' Everyone was whooping and jeering And Ryan , the boy you've watched grow up , the one you've always thought was decent and reliable , stood behind me and laughed bouder than anybody " The living room went dead silent . Dad stopped pacing Mom's grip on my arm loosened and fell away . The anger on their faces drained , replaced by shock and disbelief " He ... he did that ? " Mom whispered , her skin going pale Chapter 5 " I treated him like he was part of my future , " I said . " He treated me like a joke . " I continued . " I can't stay at that school .

I can't face him every day . I can't face the people who watched it happen . I can't pretend nothing happened . " I looked straight at them , unwavering . " So I withdrew from the university , " I said . " This isn't a tantrum , and it isn't a joke . It's my decision , and all the paperwork is already done . " I wasn't here to negotiate . " I'm not here to ask permission . I'm here to tell you . " Then I stopped looking at them . I grabbed my suitcase and walked straight to my room . The door slammed shut behind me with a hard bang , cutting off every sound and every stare on the other side .

I knew it was cruel . But this was a door I had to close with my own hands . From now on , my life was mine to run . chapters.title: Chapter 6
chapters.content:
Chapter 5 Chapter 6 I shut myself in my room . Through the door , I could hear my parents arguing in the living room with their voices forced low , and my mom's on - and - off sobs threading through it . Not long after , the landline rang . My mom answered , trying to keep it polite at first , but it quickly turned into a fight . I didn't need to guess who was calling . It was the Shaw family . The storm's center had already shifted from the school to the space between our two ordinary working - class families .

A couple dozen miles away , the atmosphere at the Shaw house was even heavier , thick with fury . When Ryan got home . he walked straight into his father's livid face and his mother's swollen , red eyes . " You finally decided to come back ? " Mr. Shaw Sr. sat on the couch with a newspaper clenched in his hand , his knuckles white from the pressure . After I'd shaken him off at the campus gate , Ryan had been stuck in a loop of panic and irritation . He'd called me dozens of times and sent dozens of WhatsApp messages , all of them vanishing into silence .

He'd assumed I was hiding to make him sweat . He never imagined I'd actually withdraw from the university . He was still reeling from that shock when he came home and met his parents ' verdict . " Dad . Mom , what's going on ? " he asked , forcing a casual tone as he reached to drop his backpack . " Stand right there . " Mr. Shaw Sr.'s voice dropped into a growl , and he slammed the newspaper onto the coffee table . " Look at what you've done . " Mrs. Shaw pointed at him , too angry to get the words out at first . Then tears spilled again . " I called Mr. and Mrs. Grant . Anna ...

Anna really withdrew from the university . She's already on a train home . " Ryan's face went dead white . The one thing he dreaded , the one thing he refused to belleve , had just been confirmed in the bluntest way possible . " She ... how could she do this ? " he muttered , sounding wounded and indignant , like he'd been betrayed . It was a joke . Did she really have to take it this far ? What does she think our eighteen years meant ? " A loud smack rang out . A hard slap cracked across his face . It was Mr. Shaw Sr. , who'd been silent until that moment .

Ryan froze , palm pressed to his cheek , staring at his father like he couldn't process It . His dad had never laid a hand on him in his life . " You worthless idiot . " Mr. Shaw Sr. was shaking with rage . " You still think she's the one making a scene ? You humiliated that girl in front of the entire school , ruined her hair , stomped on her dignity , and you're calling that a joke ? What is wrong with you ? " " I ... I was just trying to get along with Sloane's crowd , " Ryan stammered , words tumbling over each other .

" Sloane said I had to prove it , that I'd cut ties with the past for good . " " So you used Anna as your proof of loyalty ? " Mr. Shaw Sr. snapped , fury rising higher . " You used the girl who's been devoted to you , the girl both our families watched grow up , and you used her as a stepping - stone for yourself ? " His voice grew harsher . " Do you have any conscience at all ? You've made a disgrace of our name , and you've trashed decades of friendship between our families . You did all of that by yourself . " Beside him , Mrs. Shaw cried harder . " Mr.

Grant said Anna told them everything . He was so angry he could barely speak . How are we supposed to fix this ? How does this end ? " Ryan finally panicked for real . He'd never seen his parents this furious , and he'd never imagined something he thought would blow over as a " small thing " could trigger a chain reaction this violent . He wasn't terrified because I'd been hurt . He was terrified because it had spun out of control , and he could feel the consequences rushing toward him . " Dad ... Mom ... what am I supposed to do ?

" he asked at last , and the fear finally showed on his face . Mr. Shaw Sr. pointed at the front door , each word clipped and absolute . " Right now , you go to the Grants ' place . You apologize in person . I don't care what you say or what you do . If you have to get on your knees , you do it , and you talk Anna into going back to school . " " Right now ? Ryan stared , stunned . " Right now . " Mr. Shaw Sr. grabbed the car keys off the coffee table and threw them at him. I don't care how you manage it . If Anna doesn't go back to school , don't you come back here .

I don't have a son like you Ryan caught the cold keys , his palm slick with sweat . That was when it finally sank in . The " surprise " he'd staged with his own hands had turned into a disaster he couldn't control . And he was about to face the first judgment for his stupidity and cruelty . chapters.title: Chapter 7
chapters.content:
I stayed locked in my room . The door shut out the rest of the house , but it couldn't block the sound of my parents ' muffled fighting or my mom's broken , stop - and - start crying . I knew they needed time to digest what had happened , and they needed somewhere to pour all their shock and anger . I needed the same thing , an absolutely quiet space to set down a heart that felt hollowed out . I didn't know how much time had passed before everything outside went suddenly still . Then came pounding on the front door , fast and hard , like whoever it was wanted to smash their way through .

" Who is it ? " my mom called , her voice tight with tears and suspicion . A familiar male voice answered , frantic and unsteady . " Mrs. Grant , it's me , Ryan . I'm here to see Anna ... I'm here to apologize to her . " The living room dropped into a dead silence . A few seconds later , I heard my dad's voice , packed tight with rage . " You've got some nerve showing up here . " " Mr. Grant , Mrs. Grant , please , just let me see Anna . " Ryan sounded like he was crying , his words soaked in dramatic repentance that rang completely fake . " I know I was wrong . I really know .

" I didn't move . I sat at my desk and listened . I could picture his face perfectly , the same urgent regret every selfish person performs when their comfort is threatened In the end , the front door opened . Maybe my parents wanted to look him in the eye and ask how he could do it . " Where is she ? " Ryan asked , desperate . " Where's Anna ? " " She doesn't want to see you , " my mom said coldly , with none of her old warmth left . ' Mrs. Grant , 1- ' That was when I opened my bedroom door from the inside .

I stood in the doorway , calm , and looked at the familiar figure in our living room . The second he saw me , it was like he'd found a lifeline . He lunged toward me . ' Anna ! " My dad's broad frame stepped in front of me at once , like a wall . " Stop . His voice was low , hard , and full of warning . " Stay away from my daughter . " Chapter 7 70 002 Ryan froze in place . He took in my dad's icy stare , then looked at me and forced a smile that was uglier than crying " Anna , don't be mad , okay ? " he pleaded . " Last night ... I was a bastard . I was wrong . It was just a joke .

I didn't think you'd take it this seriously . I- " " A joke ? " I cut in softly . My voice wasn't loud , but it made the air in the room feel colder . I stepped out from behind my dad and stared straight into Ryan's panicked eyes . " Ryan . in front of over a thousand people , you held my shoulders down to impress another woman and let her ruin the hair I'd grown for years like I was a toy . " My tone didn't rise or shake . " You crushed my dignity under your feet and made the whole school laugh at me , and now you're telling me it was a joke?

" I sounded like I was reciting something that happened to someone else . But each word landed like a spike . Ryan's lips trembled , and he couldn't get out a full sentence . " I ... I didn't mean it like that . I just ... Sloane , she- " You just wanted to fit into her circle , so you needed a ' proof of loyalty , ' right ? " I said it for him . " And I was the easiest sacrifice , the ' friend ' you've known for eighteen years , the one who always did what you wanted , the one who was convenient and wouldn't fight back .

" His face shifted from pale to sickly , and his eyes started darting away . I'd hit the filthiest part of the truth , and he couldn't stand to look at it . " No , " he insisted weakly . " Anna , we've had eighteen years together . Doesn't that matter more than this one thing ? " Then he grabbed for the heaviest leverage we had . " If you do this , what are Mr. and Mrs. Grant supposed to do ? What are my parents supposed to do ? Our families- " Enough " My dad finally exploded , his restraint snapping . " Enough . " My mom's eyes were red , and she pointed at the door . " Get out .

You're not welcome here . Anna has made her decision . and nobody is changing it . Don't come back and bother her again . " Ryan truly panicked . He looked at the three of us , united against him , and he seemed to understand that words weren't going to save him anymore . His knees buckled , and with a heavy thud , he dropped to the floor and knelt in my direction . " Anna . I'm begging you . " He sobbed , tears and snot running down his face . " Go back to school with me I was wrong . I'm Chapter 7 on my knees . I'm apologizing . If you go back , I'll do anything you want .

You can't withdraw from the university If you withdraw , my dad will kill me . " That kneel wasn't remorse . It was a plea for me to let him off the hook , a plea to spare him from consequences . It was pathetic . It was ridiculous . I looked down at him , at the person I once believed would matter most in my life , and the last trace of warmth inside me finally went out . " Ryan . " I said , my voice like ice , " save your cheap performance . Your apology is as disgusting as your kneeling . " I turned to my parents . " Dad , Mom , get him out of here . I never want to see this person again .

" Then I didn't spare him another glance . I walked back into my room and shut the door hard . Outside , I heard my parents yelling at him to leave , and Ryan's desperate crying as he begged and begged . In the end , it all collapsed into one final , violent slam of the front door . chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.content:
Chapter 8 After Ryan was thrown out , the living room stayed silent for a long time . I could hear my mom trying to stifle her sobs and my dad letting out heavy , worn - out sighs . I opened my bedroom door and walked out . The moment my mom saw me , she wiped at her tears and stood up like she wanted to say something , but her lips moved and nothing came . My dad sat on the couch . In one night , he looked years older . He lifted a hand and gestured . " Anna , come sit . " I walked over and sat in the armchair across from them .

" Kid , " my dad said hoarsely , guilt thick in his voice , " this is on us. " My mom choked out , " My baby , you went through something like that , and you didn't tell us right away . If you'd told us sooner , we ... " " And then what ? " I asked calmly , looking at them . " Would you have stormed the school and made a scene with Ryan and his parents ? " I didn't wait for an answer . " And after that ? Everyone would know . I'd stay at that school under a spotlight of pity and gossip , seeing him and his girlfriend every day , pretending nothing happened . " My words left them speechless .

Yes , that kind of " solution " would've been a longer , slower torture for me . " So withdrawing was the best way out I could think of , " I continued . " Cut the Gordian knot . It hurts , but the wound closes faster . " I held their gaze . I'm going to take a post - grad year and reapply to colleges . " That decision hit even harder than the word withdrew . Both my parents stared at me , stunned . " A post - grad year ? " My dad's brow knotted " Anna , have you really thought this through ? A post - grad year is brutal , even tougher than senior year . " " I'm not afraid of hard work .

" I said , my eyes steady . " And this time . I'm doing it for myself . " To end up at the same college as Ryan . I'd given up a major I was genuinely interested in and switched into computer science because it was what he liked . To keep things convenient for him . I'd also given up chances farther away in bigger 80.00 % Chapter 8 cities . My life had been tied up in that so - called childhood - best - friends bond for too long . " This time .

" I said , and there was no room for doubt in my voice , " I'm going to the city I want , studying what I want , somewhere with no Ryan and no familiar faces , a place where I can start over . " My dad looked at me for a long time . The tight knot in his brow slowly loosened , replaced by something like relief and pride . He nodded hard . " Good . I support you . If you want a post - grad year , then we'll do a post - grad year . There are plenty of roads in this world , and we're not walking the one that makes you miserable . " My mom looked from me to my dad .

She wiped her face , then nodded with force . " Yes . Our Anna is smart . Try again , and you'll get into an even better school I support you too . " Right then , the landline rang again . My mom went to answer it . She barely got out a single " Hello " before her face changed . " Mrs. Shaw , " she said coldly , distant as a stranger , " I don't think there's anything left to talk about . " Whatever came through the receiver made her voice jump , sharp with fury . " Your son did nothing wrong ? Your son was just joking ? " Then she snapped , the words coming fast .

" Donna Shaw , do you have any shame at all ? Your son crushed my daughter's dignity in front of the whole school , and you're calling it a joke ? " Her hand tightened around the phone . " Let me be crystal clear . My daughter withdrew from the university and she's home . The bond between our families ended the moment your son picked up those scissors . Don't call this number again . We're done . " She slammed the receiver down . Afterward , she looked like she'd spent her last bit of strength .

chapters.title: Chapter 9
chapters.content:
80.00 % Chapter 9 After I decided to do a post - grad year and reapply , the cloud hanging over our house lifted by half . My parents stopped sighing and started moving , busy in a way that looked like hope . Dad called my old high school to ask about enrolling me for a post - grad year . Mom started researching all kinds of nutritious recipes , saying she was going to build back everything I'd run down during senior year . The mood in our home shifted , from suffocating grief to a kind of hopeful , purposeful bustle . After two days of rest and a full mental reset , I got to work too .

The first thing I did was get a haircut . I walked into a neighborhood salon that had been there for more than a decade . The owner , Ms. Delaney , saw me and froze , her mouth falling open . " Anna ? " she blurted . " Your hair ... did you do this yourself ? How did it end up like this ? " I faced the mirror and stared at the mess Sloane and Ryan had ruined together . It looked like an ugly brand , stamped into me to keep that night's humiliation fresh . " Ms. Delaney , " I said evenly , " cut it off . " " Shorter ? " she asked . " Yeah . " I met my own eyes in the mirror .

" Give me the shortest men's cut you've got , the cleaner and sharper the better . " She was clearly full of questions , but she picked up her scissors and got to work anyway . The scissors went snip , snip , snip beside my ears . This time I didn't feel fear or that icy numbness , only a rush of relief that felt almost pleasurable . Clumps of uneven hair kept falling , and it felt like pieces of that heavy past were dropping with them . Half an hour later , Ms. Delaney set her tools down .

I looked at myself and barely recognized the girl in the mirror , and somehow everything about her felt clearer My face was fully exposed now , clean and unobstructed Without long hair softening anything my features looked sharper , steadier , more determined . The short hair lay fresh against my scalp , outlining my head in crisp lines . It made me look like something stubborn that could break through frozen ground and still stand up straight . " You look great . " Ms. Delaney said , genuinely impressed . " You've got a good face . You can pull off anything .

" I smiled , paid , and stepped outside . Sunlight warmed the top of my new haircut . I touched the back of my neck , smooth and cool without any heavy hair clinging there . It felt like I'd shed a thick , suffocating shell , and my whole body felt lighter . The second thing I did was go to the biggest bookstore downtown and buy prep materials . I moved through the aisles like muscle memory , choosing what I needed . One book after another , until a small mountain formed by my feet . I was hunched over , flipping through a SAT vocabulary workbook , when my phone buzzed .

A WhatsApp message popped up from Brooke Lawson , the girl who'd sat next to me in high school . We'd ended up at the same college , just in different schools . Brooke : [ Anna , are you okay ? I heard ... you withdrew from the university ? ] Brooke : [ The campus forum is blowing up . Everyone's talking about the Welcome Show . Ryan's been acting like he's not even in his own body these past few days . Sloane and her friends are telling everyone you're being dramatic , that you can't take a joke , and that you did this on purpose to ruin Ryan's reputation .

] Brooke : [ Don't believe their garbage . A lot of us are on your side . What Ryan did was way over the line . ] A flicker of warmth moved through me as I read her messages . But when it came to Ryan and Sloane , I felt nothing at all . Their world , their noise , their scrambling excuses , it all belonged to some other dimension now , loud and far away . I didn't want to step back into it , and I didn't care to watch . My battlefield was right in front of me , these books in my hands . My goal was the SAT next June , and everything that came after it . I replied to Brooke . Me : I'm fine .

Don't worry about me ] Me : [ I'm going to do a post - grad year and reapply , and I'm at the bookstore buying prep materials ] Me : I've gotta go . I hope you have an amazing college year ] I wasn't that girl anymore , the one living in an ivory tower , spinning in circles around one person . My name is Anna Grant . I'm eighteen , and I'm officially a proud fifth - year senior doing a post - grad year and reapplying Chapter 9 Netshort 90.00 % to colleges . My new life started today , right here .

chapters.title: Chapter 10
chapters.content:
Later , I got into a top university . I never asked about Ryan again . College was even richer and more alive than I'd imagined : I threw myself into it like a dried - out sponge , hungry for every ounce of knowledge I could soak up . Time flew . In a blink , my freshman year was almost over . Because my grades were so strong , I won a national scholarship . I was also chosen to speak as the student representative at our department's year - end assembly . In that moment , I felt like something that could actually shine . When I finished , the room erupted into thunderous applause .

That night , I called home to share the news . My parents were so excited they could barely get the words out , praising me over and over for " making something of myself . " While we were talking . Mom suddenly remembered something and said it like she was bringing up neighborhood gossip . " Oh , Anna , one more thing , " she said casually . " The other day I heard from Mrs. Henderson that the Shaws couldn't stay out at their place in the county anymore . " My heart gave a small , involuntary twitch , and then it settled again . Mom kept going , her voice steady .

" Apparently Ryan owed money , and debt collectors showed up at the house . It turned into a whole disaster . " She paused , and her tone shifted into something heavier . " His dad , the one who'd already had a serious stroke before , got pushed over the edge by all that stress . " Mom exhaled softly . " He didn't make it . " My fingers tightened around the phone for a second . " Then what ? " I asked , my voice flat . * After the funeral , " Mom said , and there was no gloating in her tone , only a distant sense of how life changes and never goes back , " Donna couldn't handle it .

She had a breakdown , and her side of the family took her in " * As for Ryan , nobody really knows , " she went on " Some people say he left with the collectors , some say he ran off to another state . Either way , he disappeared . No one's seen him , and no one even knows whether he's alive or dead , and their old house out there is basically abandoned . " Watchort A person who'd taken up eighteen years of my life , the " good , reliable kid " my parents used to praise , vanished into the crowd in the messiest , ugliest way possible .

That ending was the result of choices he made , step by step . The moment he lifted those scissors , he cut off his own way back , and he cut off his future too . " It's over , " I said quietly , to my mom and to myself . " Yeah . " Mom sighed . " It's over . I'm not talking about that bad luck anymore . " Then her voice brightened , proud and fierce . " My daughter is doing amazing . Your life is only going to get better from here . " After I hung up . I stood on my dorm balcony and looked out at the city lights . The world was huge .

Every day , countless stories began , collided , ended , and began again . Ryan's story was finished . Mine was just opening to its best chapter yet .
